failedTasks.failure: This AI request contains likely identifying information. Review the case text, instructions, and conversation before trying again.

failureDiagnosis.finding: The generated heading ## Question followed by the ordinary question What is already done forms Question\nWhat is. The existing person-name detector reads Question\nWhat as a two-word name followed by is. The case context, directory text and question independently pass the same detector.
failureDiagnosis.remedy: Change the prompt section boundary so a heading cannot form a name with the following question; preserve the identifier detector and add an outbound regression.
failureDiagnosis.comparisonTreatment: Repeat all candidates on the corrected frozen source. Do not count this blocked request as a model-quality failure. Retain this original 39-request, 39-of-40-task result and its cost in total experiment spending.
